answers.answer: Shuffle 12 Speed cards, 3 Starting Upgrade cards, and 3 Stress cards into the initial draw deck. Place 6 Heat face up on the Engine spot. Start in 1st gear and draw 7 cards.
answers.evidence: Setup 4–6, 9: "Shuffle your 12 Speed cards, 3 Starting Upgrade cards, and 3 Stress cards together"; "Place 6 Heat cards face up on the Engine spot"; "Set Gear pawn to 1st gear"; "Draw 7 cards".

answers.answer: Yes, you may stay in the same gear. You may shift from 1st to 3rd by paying 1 Heat immediately during Shift Gears, moving it from Engine to discard. That Heat must be available in the Engine.
answers.evidence: Shift Gears: "Stay in your current gear"; "shift two positions by immediately paying 1 Heat during this step: move a Heat card from your Engine to your discard pile."

answers.answer: No. With enough playable cards in 3rd gear, commit exactly 3 cards face down.
answers.evidence: Play Cards: "Play cards from hand face down equal to your gear number"; "3rd = 3".

answers.answer: Steps 1 and 2 happen simultaneously, in that order. Step 3 begins only once everyone has completed both. Each player finishes all steps 3–9 before the next begins step 3. Frontmost acts first; among side-by-side cars, the car closest to the Race Line acts first.
answers.evidence: Turn Structure: "Wait until everyone has finished both steps before starting step 3." Sequential Phase: "Each player completes all of steps 3–9 before the next player begins step 3"; the Race Line car "is ahead for all purposes, including turn order."

answers.answer: Cars cannot block passage. If both destination spots are occupied, place your car in the first free spot behind the blocking cars, preferring the spot closest to the Race Line if available.
answers.evidence: Blocked Movement: "Cars never block passage"; "first free spot behind the blocking cars." Reveal & Move: "Place your car on the spot closest to the Race Line if available."

answers.answer: Immediately discard the flipped Heat and Starting Upgrade cards. Put Speed 3 in your Play Area on top of the played Stress; the Stress stays underneath in the Play Area. This Stress supplies speed 3. Discard both during Replenish Hand. Resolve it before Adrenaline.
answers.evidence: Stress Cards: "Immediately discard each flipped non-Speed card, including Heat, Stress and Starting Upgrade cards"; "Put the found Speed card in your Play Area on top of the played Stress card"; "Discard both during Replenish Hand"; "Resolve all played Stress cards before moving on to Adrenaline."

answers.answer: The last two cars to move receive Adrenaline. Each gets access to 1 extra Cooldown and may add 1 extra speed during React. The extra speed may be taken before or after Boost. Unused Adrenaline cannot be saved.
answers.evidence: Adrenaline: "If the race started with 5 or more cars, the last two cars to move receive these benefits"; "1 extra Cooldown and may add 1 extra speed"; "before or after Boost"; "Unused Adrenaline cannot be saved".

answers.answer: Yes. 2nd gear provides Cooldown 1, so during React you can return the Heat from hand to Engine, then immediately spend it from Engine to discard to Boost. Cooldown and Boost may be activated in any order.
answers.evidence: React: "Activate available Cooldown and/or Boost symbols in any order"; "Cooldown Heat from your hand into your Engine, then immediately spend it to Boost." Cooldown: "2nd gear (Cooldown 1)".

answers.answer: Boost at most once per turn during React. Pay 1 Heat from Engine to discard. With an empty Engine you cannot choose Boost unless you first return Heat using available Cooldown. Flip from the draw deck, immediately discarding non-Speed cards until a Speed card appears; add it to the Play Area and move its value. Its speed counts for corner checks.
answers.evidence: Boost: "Once per turn during React, pay 1 Heat from Engine to discard"; "until you reveal a Speed card"; "Boost increases your total speed for corner checks." Paying Heat: "You cannot choose to Boost without a Heat card available in your Engine"; may first use Cooldown.

answers.answer: Slipstream is optional. Check speed 6, excluding the two Slipstream movement spaces. Crossing the corner still requires its check, and you pay 2 Heat for exceeding limit 4 by 2.
answers.evidence: Slipstream: "optionally move 2 spaces forward"; "does NOT increase your speed for corner checks, but crossing a Corner Line this way still requires checking that corner." Check Corner: "pay Heat equal to the excess".

answers.answer: Check both corners in the order crossed. At speed 8, pay 2 Heat for limit 6, then 4 Heat for limit 4: 6 Heat altogether.
answers.evidence: Check Corner: "Check every Corner Line crossed this turn ... in the order crossed"; "For each corner separately"; "Use the same total speed for each corner"; "pay Heat equal to the excess".

answers.answer: You owe 3 Heat but only have 2, so discard both remaining Engine Heat and spin out. Move back to the first available space before that corner. Take 2 extra Stress directly into your hand because you were in 4th gear, and set your gear to 1st.
answers.evidence: Spin Out: "move all remaining Engine Heat to your discard pile"; "first available space before the corner that caused the spin out"; "2 if you were in 3rd/4th gear"; "directly into your hand"; "move your Gear pawn to 1st gear."

answers.answer: You may optionally discard unwanted Speed cards, but neither Stress nor Heat. You may browse neither your own nor another player's discard pile. Only the top card of each discard pile is public.
answers.evidence: Discard: "Optionally discard unwanted cards from hand, but never Stress or Heat cards"; "Nobody may browse any discard pile, including their own; only the top card of each pile is public knowledge."

answers.answer: Move all cards from your Play Area to your discard pile, then draw only enough to bring your hand to 7; do not draw seven additional cards.
answers.evidence: Replenish Hand: "Move all Play Area cards to your discard pile, then draw only enough cards to bring your hand back to 7. Do not draw seven additional cards."

answers.answer: Immediately shuffle the discard pile into a new draw deck and continue the interrupted Stress flips. Cards still in the Play Area are excluded because they have not yet been discarded.
answers.evidence: Running Out of Cards: "immediately shuffle your discard pile into a new draw deck, then continue the interrupted draws or flips"; "This applies during Stress"; "Do not include cards still in your Play Area".

answers.answer: Paying Heat moves it from Engine to discard. It can then cycle through the draw deck into hand and return from hand to Engine through Cooldown. Normally you may neither play Heat nor voluntarily discard it from hand; the forced Cluttered Hand rule is an exception.
answers.evidence: Paying Heat: "from your Engine to your discard pile." Heat Card Cycle: "Engine to discard to draw deck to hand; only returns to Engine via Cooldown." Special Rules: "cannot normally be played or voluntarily discarded from hand"; forced Cluttered Hand exception.

answers.answer: Commit both playable cards and fill the remaining two required slots with 2 Heat cards in the Play Area. Move zero spaces, set gear to 1st, and discard all four committed cards, including those Heat cards. Skip directly to step 9 to replenish. You skip React and cannot Cooldown or Boost this turn.
answers.evidence: Cluttered Hand: "commit all playable cards you can and fill the remaining required slots with Heat cards"; "moves zero spaces"; "Set your gear to 1st, discard all committed cards"; "skip directly to step 9"; "You skip React, so cannot Cooldown or Boost this turn."

answers.answer: Crossing first does not automatically win when cars finish in the same round. The car furthest ahead wins; closest to the Race Line breaks a side-by-side tie. At the end of the round, remove all cars that crossed the final finish line and put them in finishing order on the Hall of Fame.
answers.evidence: Scoring / Victory Conditions: "If multiple cars finish in the same round, the car furthest ahead wins (closest to Race Line breaks ties)"; "At the end of the round, remove all cars that crossed the final finish line".

answers.answer: You cannot Slipstream across the final finish line, or Slipstream after already crossing it through normal movement. After that final crossing, ignore corner speed limits beyond the finish line and move as far as you can.
answers.evidence: Scoring / Victory Conditions: "On the final lap, you cannot Slipstream across the finish line, and cannot Slipstream after crossing it"; "ignore the speed limits of corners beyond it and move as far as you can."

answers.answer: Both remaining cars receive Adrenaline, because eligibility uses the six cars that started the race. Races starting with at least five cars grant it to the last two cars to move, even after finishers leave.
answers.evidence: Adrenaline: "If the race started with 5 or more cars, the last two cars to move receive these benefits"; "Use the number of cars that started the race, even after finishers leave the track."
